hospital_live_births_vs_nbs.note: [NHC 住院分娩月报活产数, NBS births]; agree within ~1%. NBS 2020-2022 births are from memory of NBS bulletins except 2022 (956万, confirmed in 中国日报网 article); the 活产数 are from the 2023 卫生健康统计年鉴 table 8-3-1

discrepancies: Births 2024: official 9.54M vs UN WPP 2024 projection 8.82M (+8.1% official). WPP was finalised before the 2024 Dragon-year rebound; for 2023 the WPP estimate of 8.90M is within 1.3% of the official 9.02M.
Births 2025: official 7.92M vs WPP 2024 projection 8.71M (official 9.1% lower). This is a projection miss, not proof of misreporting.
Deaths: official 10.93M (2024) and 11.31M (2025) vs WPP 11.68M and 11.72M (UN 3.6-6.8% higher). The 2023 WPP estimate is about 5% above NBS. This is a persistent, systematic gap.
Life expectancy 2024: NHC 79.0 vs UN WPP 2024 78.02 (about 1 year higher). For 2023, WHO GHO gives 77.9. In 2020 the census figure (77.93) and WPP (78.02) agree.

IMR 2025: the NHC statistical bulletin says 3.8‰, but an NHC press conference on 2026-06-01 said 3.5‰. This is an internal inconsistency in official figures, possibly from different coverage. For 2024, official 4.0‰ vs UN IGME 4.1‰ (close).
Sex ratio at birth 2024: official 111.7 (hospital-delivery data) vs WPP-modelled 110.3. 2020 census sample: 112.28.
Urbanisation 2024: NBS 67.00% vs UN WUP-based World Bank 65.89%. This is definitional.

Census quality: NBS post-enumeration survey found 0.05% omission. Academic work (人口研究 2015) estimated 7.7% under-count of ages 0-5 in the 1990 census and an implied TFR of about 1.6 vs lower official survey values. No equivalent published estimate for the 2020 census was found.
Internal check: NHC hospital live births (2022: 9,587,512) vs NBS births (956万) agree within about 0.3%.
江西 2020 male life expectancy is printed as 78.08 in the NHC yearbook, above the total of 77.64. This is almost certainly a typo, so the male value is flagged.
gaps: 2025 provincial births, birth rates and urbanisation from provincial 2025 bulletins: delegated, but not returned before handback. Only 2024 values (NBS yearbook) are included.
Provincial life expectancy newer than 2021 (2023-2025 provincial 卫健委 figures): not collected. le_latest = 2021 NHC/NBS joint estimate (total only).
Provincial infant mortality: not collected. National urban/rural fallback provided. East/central/west IMR split not found.
Birth order after 2022 (NHC stopped publishing the split in bulletins found). Official mean age of mothers at birth is not published; computed from 2020 census ASFRs.
NBS 2020/2021 birth counts in data_quality.hospital_live_births_vs_nbs are from memory (12.02M, 10.62M). Only 2022 (956万) was verified.
